trait_ArvakTheUnrelenting_Haunted_info: A mysterious entity pursues the marked. The curse can begin manually or through a rare, optional origin.
TestMode: Quick test: guaranteed attempt after 10 s
EnableRandomOrigins Description: Allow a very rare Haunted curse to begin automatically. Off by default; manual application always works.
ChancePerAttemptPercent Description: Probability of an automatic Haunted origin on each scheduled attempt. Ignored in quick test mode.
AttemptIntervalSeconds Description: Real seconds between automatic origin attempts when quick test mode is disabled.
TestMode Description: For testing only: when random origins are enabled, attempt a guaranteed Haunted origin after 10 real seconds if an eligible creature exists. Repeat works when enabled.
RepeatAutomaticOrigins: Repeat random origins after a curse ends
RepeatAutomaticOrigins Description: When enabled, schedule another random origin after all existing Haunted victims are gone. Never starts a second chain while the previous one is active.
EnableWitnessTracking Description: Observe Haunted deaths and correlate nearby actors whose confirmed kill counters increased. Does not cause transmission.
EnableKillerTransfer Description: OFF by default. When exactly one nearby actor gains one kill during the scan, transfer Haunted to that candidate. Attribution is inferred, not a guaranteed damage-source event.
MaxKillerDistance Description: Maximum distance between the death location and the probable killer. Shorter ranges reduce false positives but miss ranged attacks.
VerboseWitnessLogs Description: Log internal counts every scan while a Haunted victim is alive. Useful for testing; noisy in normal gameplay.
EnableAdaptiveTracking Description: Refresh pursuit orders faster near the victim (0.18 seconds very close; 1.6 seconds when far). Global world scanning remains every 2 seconds.
OverrideNormalBehaviors Description: Periodically interrupt the possessed creature's normal activities (including sleep) to favor continuous pursuit. Experimental.
EnableStuckRescue Description: If distance to victim does not improve for an extended period, possess another eligible creature closer to the victim. Helps with water and obstacles, but does not guarantee crossings without an eligible host.
StuckThresholdSeconds Description: Time without significant progress before attempting an alternative host. Measured in real seconds; game speed has no effect.
VerbosePursuitLogs Description: Logs extra behavior overrides. Core progress and rescue events are logged even when this is off.
EnableAntiKite Description: If a victim circles the nearby pursuer for long enough, roll a configurable chance of a short supernatural sprint. On by default, but no longer guaranteed.
AntiKiteRadius Description: The victim must remain this close to the current pursuer. Brief exits shorter than 2 seconds are tolerated.
AntiKiteSeconds Description: Time spent close to the same pursuer before a circling pattern can trigger the punishment. Proximity alone is not enough.
AntiKiteBoostDuration Description: Real-time duration of a massive temporary speed bonus (+75 speed stat). The unit resumes its prior movement mode afterwards.
AntiKiteCooldown Description: Minimum wait after the speed boost ends before another punishment can trigger for this body and victim.
VerboseAntiKiteLogs Description: Log distance and circular movement metrics every five seconds while close to the entity.
trait_ArvakTheUnrelenting_PunishingRush_: The entity is moving with terrifying, unnatural speed for a short time.
TrackViolentDeaths Description: Track dead creatures and nearby kill-counter changes; a verified burning status can also qualify. Detection by polling is approximate. Does not infect anyone on its own.
EnableTraumaTransfer: Transmit Haunted to a nearby witness (experimental)
EnableTraumaTransfer Description: OFF by default. After a probably violent death, one nearby eligible humanoid may receive Haunted: Trauma (not normal Haunted). Proximity does not prove sight.
IncludeNonHauntedDeaths Description: Allow an unrelated probable homicide or burning death to start the curse through a nearby witness; otherwise only deaths of previously Haunted creatures qualify.
TraumaRadius Description: Maximum distance between the last known death position and a nearby humanoid witness. Proximity is NOT verified visibility.
TraumaChancePercent Description: Chance for the selected witness to gain Haunted: Trauma. Prior exposures add up to 15 percentage points, capped at 100%.
TraumaCooldownSeconds: Minimum time between trauma transmissions (real s)
TraumaCooldownSeconds Description: Global real-time cooldown after successful transfer to prevent a mass chain of infections. Does not stop manually assigned Haunted.
VerboseTraumaLogs Description: Show ignored deaths, cooldown skips and periodic counters. Can be noisy on large worlds.
trait_ArvakTheUnrelenting_HauntedTrauma_: Cursed after witnessing a potentially violent death. The same mysterious entity pursues this creature; the different name identifies the traumatic origin.
trait_ArvakTheUnrelenting_HauntedBloodli: Inherited after the entity killed a confirmed ancestor. The same relentless entity pursues this bloodline heir.
EnableBloodlineTransfer Description: OFF by default. After an execution by the entity, transfer Haunted: Bloodline to ONE living descendant, but only when an explicit parent-child link can be verified. No city, surname or family-group guesses.
BloodlineChancePercent Description: Chance for the verified heir to inherit the curse after the entity kills an ancestor. Set to 100% to test.
BloodlineMaxGenerations Description: Search direct children first, then grandchildren and great-grandchildren up to this depth (1 to 3). If a closer generation has eligible descendants, prefer it.
VerboseBloodlineLogs Description: Show lineage candidate and failure information when the entity executes a victim. Does not create relationships or transmit the curse by itself.
EnablePresenceCue Description: Play randomly selected quiet sounds after the controlled Haunted victim stays near the pursuer. Does not actually detect player awareness.
EnableDeathJumpscare Description: Optional fullscreen image and sound after death by the entity. Only when the game positively identifies the controlled victim (off by default).
JumpscareChancePercent Description: Chance of a jumpscare after the possessed victim is killed by the entity (0-100%).
ImmersionSoundVolumePercent Description: Extra immersion sound volume. Audio files are pre-attenuated, and playback volume is applied before unpausing.
ShowDiagnosticHud Description: Show debug counters and pursuer information on screen. Spoils the mystery; off by default.
VerboseImmersionLogs Description: Print when controlled-character detection is unavailable or optional sound playback fails.
AntiKiteChancePercent Description: After the nearby circling requirement, roll this chance at the configured interval. 0% disables the anti-kite sprint without disabling the pursuer.
AntiKiteRollIntervalSeconds Description: While a victim keeps circling near the entity, perform one probability check every this many real seconds after the proximity requirement. No checks if not circling.
EnableRandomBurst Description: Separate from Anti-Kite: allows rare native Fast trait bursts while the pursuer moves. Disable for easier Worldfall proximity testing.
RandomBurstChancePercent Description: Chance for the ordinary Fast burst on each scheduled check (about every 12-22 real seconds). 0% suppresses bursts; does not affect anti-kite.
PresenceChancePercent Description: Chance per attempt after sustained proximity. 0% prevents proximity cues, not death scream.
PresenceRetrySeconds Description: Minimum real seconds between rolls for a proximity sound; failed rolls are normal.
PresenceMinSeconds Description: Real-time sustained proximity before first attempt; unaffected by 5x world speed.
PresenceRadius Description: Maximum distance to the pursuer to allow subtle sounds.
EnableRareGrowl Description: The growl can replace a selected cue only within 7 tiles after extended proximity.
GrowlChancePercent Description: Chance to select the growl after a cue was rolled and close range permits it; not a per-second chance.
EnableMusicDucking Description: Off by default. Attempts to lower only FMOD bus:/Music, if found, and restore afterwards; Worldfall may use separate music.
MusicDuckingPercent Description: Amount to reduce an identified music bus. Never changes Master or global volume.
AudioPreviewIndex Description: 0=cue, 1=whisper A, 2=whisper B, 3=growl, 4=death scream. Does not show jumpscare image.
PreviewAudioOnce Description: Toggle on to play one WAV independent of Worldfall. Toggle off and on to repeat. Use low volume.
